summary: Redesign everyday workflows, set AI guardrails, and create a measurable 90-day adoption plan. Explore the course and build practical team capability.
lede: AI in the workplace training helps non-technical professionals assess routine tasks for generative or agentic AI and redesign workflows with human review and information safeguards. Learners build a task inventory, draft prompts and review checks, map email, document, analysis or customer-response workflows, track effort and rework, and create a 90-day adoption plan for their function.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use office tools and need to apply generative or agentic AI safely in their daily work. It suits beginner-level learners who can describe their function's routine workflows but do not need programming experience.
audience: Finance analysts using AI support for narrative
modules: Generative AI Prompt and Review Patterns
OECD AI Principles for Customer Interactions
90-Day AI Adoption with NIST AI RMF
prerequisites: Working knowledge of your function's routine office workflows is expected. No coding or programming is required. Access to an employer-approved generative AI assistant and standard office applications supports hands-on practice; tool availability depends on your organization.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
